correctionRecord.what: The named blocker -- 'KL-000 independent reimplementation' -- was discharged by evidence this record predates, and the record did not know it. The blocker text below is preserved verbatim as superseded, not rewritten.
correctionRecord.evidence: IND-20260807-1/-2/-3 (KL-000/results/independent/): a zero-dependency Rust implementation with hand-written JSON, SHA-256 and PRNG, written from the registered documents, agreeing with the reference on the evaluator's exhaustive partitioning, the complete conclusion function (160/49,480/41,820/19,380 over all 110,840 receipts), and the canonical form and digests for the two pinned receipts C11/C12 (byte-identical, 703 and 691 bytes). Commissioned ONCE, exactly as the superseded text said it should be, serving both KL-000's gate and this kernel's prerequisite. Qualified by LEAK-101 as recorded in KL-000/FINAL-RECORD.md; the qualification travels with any KL-011 use of this artifact too.
correctionRecord.pattern: This is the stale-self-description family again -- a record whose truth expired while the world moved, detected by re-deriving from evidence rather than reading the record. Prior instances: PROV-005 (a deleted remote's cache measured as the remote), ART-101 (a result artifact carrying its predecessor's identity), TEST-101 (a projected verification value inherited unexecuted for three runs), and the DOC-102 miscount chain. The fix is the same every time: records name their evidence, and reviews re-derive rather than re-read. This record now cites what discharged its blocker instead of asserting the blocker.

nextGate: Its own work, no longer anyone else's: (1) preregistration at schema v0.2 (the v0.1 document cannot satisfy RESEARCH-METHOD.md -- SCH-001); (2) the five-stage pipeline itself (discovery, collection, provenance, decision, presentation) exchanging one bounded claim, with the registered injection set: paraphrase, retry, reordering, duplication, partial failure, one malicious duplicate, one unavailable location; (3) its fixtures, tests, and results directories (ENG-001). The two-implementation prerequisite is met in substance; what KL-011 inherits from KL-000's close must be carried into its design: A2 undecided (19,152 worlds of conclusion semantics any transaction would transport), SCH-005 (protected fields the receipt never emits cannot be shown to survive crossing systems), ADV-001 (coverage preservation is only as strong as the original declaration), and F11 (no cross-implementation randomized stream). First falsifiable step: the v0.2 preregistration, owner's to schedule.
